name: What role does landscape lighting play in a high-end outdoor living space?

mainEntity.name: What role does landscape lighting play in a high-end outdoor living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Landscape lighting is crucial in a high-end outdoor living space for both aesthetics and safety. It extends the usability of your outdoor areas into the evening, highlights architectural features and landscaping, and creates an inviting ambiance. Beyond enhancing beauty, well-placed lighting improves safety by illuminating pathways and steps. AKN Design Group integrates thoughtful lighting design into your project, ensuring it complements your overall design and enhances the nighttime appeal and functionality of your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Landscape lighting enhances beauty, extends usability, and improves safety in high-end outdoor living spaces, highlighting features and creating ambiance.
